heldCases.problem: The chapter's twelfth month of 顯德四年 runs from 壬子/癸丑 (Julian 957-12-23/24) and the next new year is 958-01-22/23 Julian. Anchors in the chapter verify the computation: 正月己丑朔 = Julian 957-02-03, 五月丁亥朔, 九月甲申朔 and 十一月癸未朔 = Julian 957-11-24 are all consistent, with no intercalary month. s0176 丙子 is Julian 958-01-16, proleptic Gregorian 958-01-21. The bounds 'onOrBefore AD 957' on claim-845/claim-850 therefore add an unsupported endpoint up to 21 days early. The audit cites no external reference narrowing either death. PEOPLE_DATE_AUDIT.md requires proleptic-Gregorian normalisation of verified month/day dates and warns that Julian December dates may fall in the next Gregorian year; approved audits apply this (for example liaoshi/117).
